integrity: Proof via feedback-table bijection, independent Euler-tour enumeration, two independent full-deck algorithms, and a complete exact class partition; checker and pair witnesses embedded.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite statement for binary order-five de Bruijn necklaces rooted at the unique 00000; no claims for other orders, roots, or deletion multiplicities. Full historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Sharp scattered-subsequence reconstruction threshold for canonical binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
